verdict.rationale: The CLI's 'ng add' command explicitly supports adding external libraries (angular-docs-16), and a community comment references Angular Material as a UI library option (angular-comm-1), suggesting some third-party component ecosystem exists. However, there's no first-party documentation cataloguing or endorsing a rich set of third-party UI libraries, and the only community mention describes Material2 as 'incomplete at alpha stage' rather than a mature ecosystem. Missing for 10: dedicated docs/marketplace listing multiple third-party component libraries, independent evidence of breadth/maturity of the ecosystem, and confirmation of widely-adopted libraries beyond one dated mention.
